description:
What You Will Do: 
 

 • Analyze network server hardware requirements and make recommendations to management 
 • Maintain documentation of all supported systems 
 • Manage user accounts, creating, updating and removing access as necessary and in adherence to Change Management Policies. 
 • Constantly monitor and assess systems to make sure that processes are operating as designed. 
 • Perform hardware and software upgrades. 
 • Maintain documentation of Hardware and Software assets 
 • Test and install issued patches in conjunction with software providers and vendors or other third parties 
 

 You Have: 
 

 • A minimum of 3 years of Windows, Solaris, Linux, Virtualization Env. VMware, ESXI, Xen and storage Systems Administration experience. 
 • Familiarity with Oracle, SQL or other database technologies a plus. 
 • At least 3 years’ experience in configuration, management and troubleshooting of networking gear Routers, switches, firewall, load balancer. 
 • Familiarity with SAN and storage systems, and Cisco UCS compute systems is a great plus. 
 • Ability to troubleshoot systems and applications in a timely manner. 
 • Understanding of critical IT facilities infrastructure and structured cabling. 
 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills. 
 • Server management knowledge including capacity planning and monitoring. 
 • Programming experience or scripting experience (PERL, UNIX shell scripts) will be an advantage. 
 • Ability to work on multiple projects at any one period of time. 
 • Demonstrated ability to prioritize and execute tasks in a fast pace, high-pressure environment and make sound decisions in emergency situations. 
 • Keen attention to detail and are highly self-motivated and directed. 
 • Strong customer service orientation. 
 • Demonstrated knowledge of system design and analysis. 
 • The ability to write concise and accurate technical documentation. 
 • Ability to maintain professional demeanor in a fast pace, high-pressure environment.

 Windows, Solaris, Linux, Virtualization Env. VMware, ESXI, Xen and storage Systems Administration,PE

 Multiple Openings for GC/Citizen
